backend/main.mo: Main Motoko canister defining user profiles, OTP challenges, banks, transactions, balances, and categorized bank list query.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that adds an empty otpChallenges map when upgrading from the old actor state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, associated frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of all major frontend components and screens.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based CSS defining color variables, themes, and base styling for the app.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML page mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling authentication, profile setup gating, and main app rendering.
frontend/src/components/BalanceCard.tsx: Component showing the user’s balance with loading state and a reward banner.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Top navigation bar showing branding, user details dropdown, and logout handling.
Component that fetches QR data and renders a QR code on a canvas using a public API with fallback handling.
frontend/src/components/QRCodeScanner.ts: Provides a QR code scanning UI using useQRScanner, handling scan start/stop, error alerts, and emitting scanned mobile numbers.
frontend/src/components/SendMoneyCard.ts: Form for sending money that validates inputs, auto-fills mobile from QR scans, and triggers sendMoney mutations.
frontend/src/components/TransactionHisto: Displays a scrollable list of transactions with loading skeletons and formatting based on transaction type.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor tied to Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity auth client, storing identity, login state, and providing login/clear functions via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls with React Query for profile, OTP, balance, transactions, and money transfer operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base layers and defines OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and the Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/LoginScreen.tsx: Implements a styled login screen with branding, feature highlights, and an Internet Identity login button.
frontend/src/pages/MainApp.tsx: Provides the main authenticated app UI with tabs for home, send, scan, QR generation, and history, using user profile data.
frontend/src/pages/ProfileSetupScreen.ts: Handles bank linking and OTP-based mobile verification with form inputs, OTP request/verify flow, and profile submission.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, persisting, and clearing URL or session parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors via OKLCH variables, adding plugins, and defining custom animations.
project_state.json: Metadata describing project features, requirements, state, and pending feature requests.
